description: Styles for button components used in the React To-Do List application, including variants for primary, secondary, danger, and sizes.

classes.name: .kavia-btn
classes.description: Base style for the button with general appearance and interactive states.

classes.name: .btn-primary
classes.description: Style for the primary button variant, including hover and active states.

classes.name: .btn-secondary
classes.description: Style for the secondary button variant, including hover and active states.

classes.name: .btn-ghost
classes.description: Style for the ghost button variant, which is transparent with contextual color.

classes.name: .btn-danger
classes.description: Style for the danger button variant, including hover and active states.

classes.name: .btn-spinner
classes.description: Style for the loading spinner within buttons, indicating processing.

classes.name: .btn-content-fade
classes.description: Style for fading effect on button content.
